issues: No [services.postgres] block at all — the rubric's one HARD service requirement is entirely missing; the manifest defers to the repo's scripts/start_dev_db.sh instead of wiring a self-initializing Flox service (no initdb, no socket, no trust auth, no lemmy DB bootstrap, no shutdown command)
No [vars] section — LEMMY_DATABASE_URL / PGHOST / PGPORT are unset, so nothing connects the installed postgresql_18 to the app's expected postgres://lemmy:password@localhost:5432/lemmy default

CARGO_TARGET_DIR deliberately left in the repo tree rather than $FLOX_ENV_CACHE; the stated reason (start_dev_db.sh writes its cluster under $PWD/target) is a consequence of not wiring the service in the first place
PQ_LIB_DIR not exported; relies solely on pkg-config plus the dev output for the pq-sys native link
Activation hook performs network/state side effects (git submodule update --init --recursive, pnpm install) — on-activate should not mutate the working tree or fetch
git installed and hook-depended-upon despite 0 git+ Cargo sources; submodule fetching is a checkout concern, not an env dep
Scope creep beyond the primary runtime: diesel-cli (own pkg-group), nodejs_24, pnpm_10, jq, pgformatter, taplo, typos, shfmt — defensible CI parity, but none substitute for the missing service
pict-rs not mentioned even as an optional external service

# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Rust toolchain, pinned to rust-toolchain.toml channel "1.95".
# Workspace MSRV floor is 1.92 (Cargo.toml rust-version).
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.version = "1.95.0"
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.version = "1.95.0"
clippy.pkg-path = "clippy"
clippy.version = "1.95.0"
rustfmt.pkg-path = "rustfmt"
rustfmt.version = "1.95.0"

# Linker, plus the C compiler for cc-built crates
# (zstd-sys, tikv-jemalloc-sys, ring).
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"

# pq-sys (via diesel's postgres backend) links libpq and locates it
# with pkg-config. postgresql_18 also supplies the pg_ctl/initdb/psql
# that scripts/start_dev_db.sh drives, and the pg_dump that the schema
# setup test requires at the server's major version.
# The "dev" output carries libpq.pc and the headers; without it pkg-config
# cannot see libpq and the pq-sys build script fails.
postgresql_18.pkg-path = "postgresql_18"
postgresql_18.outputs = ["out", "man", "dev", "lib"]
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"

# api_tests/ — .woodpecker.yml runs these on node:24-trixie-slim.
nodejs_24.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"
pnpm_10.pkg-path = "pnpm_10"

# scripts/start_dev_db.sh URL-encodes the socket dir with jq.
jq.pkg-path = "jq"

# Schema round-trip check (.woodpecker.yml check_diesel_schema), which
# diffs generated output — so the version CI pins is the one that matters.
# Its own group: 2.3.2 shares no catalog page with the pinned 1.95 toolchain.
diesel-cli.pkg-path = "diesel-cli"
diesel-cli.version = "2.3.2"
diesel-cli.pkg-group = "diesel"

# Formatters and lint gates from scripts/lint.sh and .woodpecker.yml.
pgformatter.pkg-path = "pgformatter"
taplo.pkg-path = "taplo"
typos.pkg-path = "typos"
shfmt.pkg-path = "shfmt"

# crates/email/translations is a git submodule.
git.pkg-path = "git"

[hook]
on-activate = """
